title: grease splatter screen
text: grease splatter screen. Long, long ago my mother had one of these... and it worked.  It does help to keep the grease splatter more contained.  It's not perfect, but less mess is better than nothing.  I get tired of cleaning off the difficult to clean knobs and such - The screens are easy to clean themselves - I hand wash them.  Since I don't often cook with grease - it's not that big a deal.  they are about 10" tall and, hinged so they fold up for easy storage.

product_metadata.title: Norpro 2063 Nonstick 3 Sided Splatter Guard
features: Tired of that messy splatter you get when cooking sauces, frying bacon or chicken? Protect your walls, counters and cooking area easily by using this handy and effective 3 panel splatter guard! Efficiently shields much of your stove and its surrounding environment, eliminating the mess of splattered food.
Three tall, 10” x 9” / 25.5cm x 23cm folding panels keep counters, walls and floors splatter free!
Durable nonstick finish is easy to clean!
Panels fold down for easy storage.
